headline: PPAP Automotive fixes record date for dividend
hook: November payout set for PPAP holders
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the stock exchanges that November 13, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed on the company's registry as of this date will be eligible for the payout. The announcement follows routine corporate action procedures for the automotive components maker. Retail investors holding the stock ahead of the record date qualify to receive the declared dividend.
why_it_matters: Dividend payout credited to eligible PPAP shareholders soon

headline: PPAP Automotive submits voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Court convened meeting results now public
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for the court-convened general meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing provides formal documentation of shareholder votes on matters presented at the court-convened meeting. This procedural filing is standard corporate compliance for listed entities completing court-ordered shareholder meetings. Retail investors holding PPAP Automotive shares can review the specific voting outcomes through exchange disclosures.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price
